name: Waterloo (United States)
description: Blue field with a navy blue diagonal band from the upper hoist to the lower fly, charged with the stylised letter W of the city logo in grey, light blue, green and white ribbons.
history: Waterloo is a city in and the county seat of Black Hawk County, Iowa. The flag was adopted in 2022 (the new city logo carried on the flag was presented on 1 December 2022, according to Flags of the World).

features.role: stylised letter W of the city logo in grey, light blue, green and white
